review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR and CS_ENGINE_IMAGE set); this report is derived from the recorded log plus a second record, launch-geometry.json, holding the engine image digest, the resolutions and the limitations. MEASURED by static analysis of the owner-supplied decrypted executable (byte windows and the closed caller inventory pinned in the acceptance test): VELOCITY is stored at record +0x2c, metres per second along the launch direction, applied as displacement = dt * node+0x60 each step (0x5afe3f) with the dt of the frame clock, default 120.0 and RANGE default 500.0; FIRE_RATE is stored as 1/FIRE_RATE at record +0x14 (0x5adcc9), an interval in seconds, and a mount's next-fire is the shared clock plus its +0x14 interval (0x4b6b2d) with a half-interval stagger on alternating mounts (0x4b6d26); the spawn 0x5aef40 takes the full-inheritance path node+0x60 = shooter + dir*VELOCITY via the multiply-accumulate 0x5389a0 only when ACCELERATION (+0x38) is non-zero and INSTANT (0x800) is clear, and otherwise removes the launch-direction part of the shooter velocity (0x5af315..0x5af3a3); BEAM records take a 1/TIME_TO_MAX_RANGE rate instead (0x5ad9fc) and a non-zero GRAVITY rewrites +0x2c to sqrt(2*GRAVITY*RANGE) (0x5ae505) — no retail record reaches either arm; mount entries are 0x30 bytes with next-fire +0x10, interval +0x14, enabled +0x2c (find_mount 0x4b2080). STILL UNMEASURED (none claimed): see the limitations array of launch-geometry.json. The claim is implemented: this awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
